scope: 10p/12s double-layer tooth-wound development motor, 2D cross-section with three equal skew slices; not the runtime 8p/24s adapter or a 3D/end-effect qualification.

implementation_support.fixed_geometry: Shaft radius 10.5 mm, rotor outer radius 25.6 mm, stator outer radius 46 mm, stack 35 mm
implementation_support.coordinates: Magnet thickness 1.5-4 mm, coverage 0.65-0.95, gap 0.3-1 mm, tooth fraction 0.2-0.4, opening 0.03-0.12, slot bottom radius 34-42 mm; geometry grammar must also pass
implementation_support.materials: Linear remanent magnet Br 1.2 T, relative permeability 1; Brauer nonlinear steel route without hysteresis; demagnetisation/thermal/2-second duty not modelled
implementation_support.loaded_curve: 48 signed samples, 0.25 degree spacing over the registered 12 degree window; same geometry/current/phase registration
implementation_support.current: Actual TRAIN support and registered J/phase commands, not scaler ranges as a new envelope

validity.decision_needed: Declare magnet/steel validity, saturation/demagnetisation applicability and angle/current conventions; image MMS acceptance is not nonlinear-material or torque adequacy

signed_torque_curve.note: t00-t47 in N*m plus angle/current/phase identity

signed_cogging_curve.note: J=0 route, mean/peak-to-peak in physical units; no division by near-zero mean

summary_observables.note: Mean, peak-to-peak, ripple fraction and cogging derived from the signed curves

slice_curves.note: Unaveraged registered 2D slices with phase offset; needed for independent skew accounting

vector_B_H_J_mesh.note: Element fields, coordinates, quadrature, normals and constitutive relation; optional regional B_rms sidecar is insufficient

airgap_stress_contour.note: B_r/B_theta and contour weights at registered airgap radii

energy_coenergy_angle.note: Material-consistent energy/coenergy including permanent-magnet state and fixed phase-current convention

full_closed_period_curve.note: Registered winding/rotor period and nonduplicated endpoint samples; a 12 degree loaded window alone does not prove every identity

laws.statement: div B = 0, equivalently net outward magnetic flux through a closed contour is zero
laws.conditions: Matched 2D field, mesh and out-of-plane assumptions; B=curl A in the pinned formulation
laws.calibration: Weak/contour residual, mesh refinement and trace error in magnetic-flux units; not regional RMS comparison

laws.statement: curl H = J with the pinned steel/magnet constitutive laws
laws.conditions: Magnetostatic quiescent model, correct winding signs, remanence and nonlinear steel law
laws.calibration: Weak Ampere residual and material-law mismatch separately, including nonlinear iteration and mesh error

laws.statement: Airgap Maxwell-stress torque agrees with the registered energy/coenergy derivative
laws.conditions: Identical current/PM state, stack scaling and rotor angle; use the correct fixed-current energy derivative, not naive PM energy
laws.calibration: N*m discrepancy across contour radii, mesh rungs and angular derivative steps; test end/stack modelling discrepancy separately

laws.statement: Peak-to-peak >= 0; mean and extrema lie inside the signed sampled curve; ripple uses its registered positive loaded mean
laws.conditions: Same angular sampling, unit and current command; cogging reported in N*m not as a near-zero-normalised percentage
laws.calibration: Observer algebra and angular refinement error; not a test of PDE fidelity by itself

laws.statement: Skewed torque is the mean of three slices at theta+d and loaded phase gamma-5*d
laws.conditions: 10p means five pole pairs; equal slices d=-s/2,0,+s/2; J=0 cogging uses angle shifts without a loaded phase
laws.calibration: Matched slice/averaged curves, sign and phase offset tests; no second averaging or implicit 3D claim

laws.statement: Loaded command at J=0 reduces to the registered cogging curve, not identically zero torque
laws.calibration: Matched zero-current curves and reference solver noise in N*m

laws.statement: Integral of J=0 cogging torque over a proven conservative closed period is zero
laws.conditions: Full physical/registered symmetry period, no hysteresis, fixed PM state; endpoint not double counted
laws.calibration: Angle-integrated work and finer angular quadrature; hold until period/winding equivalence is verified

laws.statement: A registered symmetry transformation of rotor, winding and electrical phase gives the correspondingly transformed torque curve
laws.conditions: Exact topology/winding/current map required; not arbitrary phase reversal or rotor-only rotation
laws.calibration: Matched transformed witnesses with identical current magnitude and material state

excluded_claims: No universal linear or monotone torque-versus-current/geometry law under saturation, reluctance torque or varying electrical phase.
No blind torque sign change under J reversal: permanent magnets, cogging and reluctance terms must be accounted for.
Buyer 6/12 N*m, ripple and cogging limits are not physics-law bounds and are not relaxed.
No demagnetisation, hysteresis, losses, temperature, voltage-speed or 2-second peak-duty safety proof from a magnetostatic torque curve.

tolerances.recipe: Common README plan; absolute N*m floors near zero, observable-specific field/flux units and independent mesh/angle uncertainty

calibration.image_basis: Owner accepted GetDP 3.5.0 A2D/P1 MMS (A order 2, B order 1); nonlinear material, PM, torque and skew adequacy are separate

probes.proposal: Registered geometry/current/phase singles, zero-current controls, exact symmetry transforms and 0/2/4 degree matched skew paths; no global monotonicity gate or runs

review_owner: Carbon Validator and science; owner adoption remains reserved
